[[Osi]] '''Hass''' was a [[Krikthasi]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At the time, he was the leader of the [[Undrarian]] ''[[junieuw]]'', presenting their support to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[bestrum algae]] harvesting plant, [[Aqualis Base]]. This allegiance, he hoped, would obtain for him high-tech weaponry so that he could destroy the [[Multopo]]s.
